title: Sky-High
intro: [excited] Look UP, everybody! Tonight it's castles, towers and heights. [whispers] If you're afraid of heights... maybe sit closer to the floor.

art.prompt: A dreamy skyline of fairy-tale spires and towers rising above the clouds at sunrise: a slender ivy-covered tower, a castle turret with flags, a snowy mountain peak and a cluster of floating balloons drifting by. Original painterly storybook illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich color, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Let Down Your Hair
categories.intro: [laughs] Seventy feet of golden hair and one VERY tall tower. It's all about Tangled!

clues.clue: In Tangled, Rapunzel spends 18 years locked away in one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a tower! [chuckles] No stairs, no doors, just a whole lot of hair.

clues.clue: This palace horse hunts Flynn Rider like a bloodhound.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maximus! [laughs] Best horse in the kingdom. Don't tell Bullseye.

clues.clue: Mother Gothel warns Rapunzel about the scary outside world in this song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mother Knows Best! [sarcastic] Spoiler: Mother did NOT know best.

clues.clue: Rapunzel sings through her daily tower chores, from painting to candle-making, in this song.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is When Will My Life Begin! [excited] Chores never sounded so peppy. My kitchen is jealous.

clues.clue: Tangled was celebrated as this milestone number in Walt Disney Animation Studios' feature list.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 50th! [dramatic pause] Fifty films... and still letting down their hair. Big nerd points.

art.prompt: A tall stone tower with a single window in a hidden valley at golden hour, a waterfall beside it, hundreds of floating paper lanterns rising into a purple sky. Original painterly storybook illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich color, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Up, Up and Away
categories.intro: Things that FLY, float and soar in Disney films. [chuckles] Fasten your seatbelts.

clues.clue: Peter Pan flies Wendy and her brothers to this magical island.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Neverland! [chuckles] Where you never grow up. My kind of place.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins floats down from the clouds holding this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an umbrella! [chuckles] Practically perfect in every way, including air travel.

clues.clue: Carl and Ellie dreamed of moving to this South American waterfall.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paradise Falls! [sighs] And yes, Angel Falls was a real-life inspiration. Close, but no cross your heart.

clues.clue: Dumbo's mouse friend Timothy gives him this 'magic' object so he'll believe he can fly.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a magic feather! [whispers] Spoiler: the magic was in Dumbo all along. Aww.

clues.clue: In Up, explorer Charles Muntz flies a giant airship named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Spirit of Adventure! [dramatic pause] Adventure is out there... and so is Muntz. Yikes.

art.prompt: A cheerful sky full of drifting things: a bundle of colorful balloons, a striped umbrella, a white feather and sparkling dust trailing among fluffy pink clouds. Original painterly storybook illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich color, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Look Up!
categories.intro: [excited] Real photos of the tallest sights in the parks! Crane your neck and buzz in.

clues.clue: This tower stands in Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland. Which film's heroine does it honor?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tangled! [laughs] Rapunzel's tower, right next to some VERY convenient restrooms.

clues.clue: Name the drop ride inside this spooky hotel at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
clues.answer: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
Guardians of the Galaxy: Mission BREAKOUT!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror! [gasps] Going DOWN! And up. And down again.

clues.clue: Name this Animal Kingdom coaster that races up a snowy Himalayan peak.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Expedition Everest! [whispers] Watch out for the locals. They're big. And furry.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Matterhorn is a 1/100 scale model of a real peak on the border of Switzerland and this country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Italy! [chuckles] Half Swiss, half Italian. Fondue AND pasta. Perfect mountain.

clues.clue: According to Disney, EPCOT's 180-foot sphere is covered with exactly this many triangular panels.
accept: eleven thousand three hundred twenty four
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 11,324! [laughs] Imagineers counted every single one. I tried once. I got to twelve.

art.prompt: A low-angle view from a theme-park walkway looking up at a mix of tall landmarks against bright blue sky: a snowy peak, a geodesic sphere and a slender storybook tower. Original painterly storybook illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich color, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Castle in the Sky
categories.intro: [dramatic pause] Every great park has a great castle. Let's storm the gates!

clues.clue: Cinderella Castle and Sleeping Beauty Castle are each surrounded by this water-filled ditch.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a moat! [chuckles] Keeps out dragons. And people who skip the line.

clues.clue: Disneyland Paris's castle, like the one in California, is named for this princess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty! [excited] Le Chateau de la Belle au Bois Dormant. Say THAT five times fast.

clues.clue: A hidden suite inside Cinderella Castle was first planned as an apartment for this man's family.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Walt Disney! [whispers] Now lucky guests sometimes win a night inside. Pack your glass slippers.

clues.clue: Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland uses this design trick, with smaller details higher up, to look taller.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is forced perspective! [laughs] The castle's like me in photos. Just angles.

clues.clue: Before Walt picked Sleeping Beauty, Disneyland's castle was first planned to be named for this princess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White! [gasps] Sleeping Beauty got the castle to promote her 1959 film. Sneaky marketing!

art.prompt: A storybook castle with blue and gold turrets reflected in a moat, a drawbridge lowered, swans gliding and fireworks bursting high above at night. Original painterly storybook illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich color, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Head in the Clouds
categories.intro: A sky-high grab bag from the fans! [mischievously] Try not to float away.

clues.clue: Dumbo learns to fly by flapping his enormous these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his ears! [excited] Best ears in the business. Flap flap flap!

clues.clue: In Frozen, Elsa builds her ice palace on this mountain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the North Mountain! [chuckles] Let it go... and let it go UP. Very high up.

clues.clue: In Mary Poppins, Uncle Albert floats to the ceiling because he can't stop doing this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is laughing! [laughs] I love to laugh... and now I'm floating. Uh oh.

clues.clue: Peter Pan's directions to Neverland: second star to the right and straight on till this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is morning! [whispers] Second star to the right... GPS could never.

clues.clue: Quasimodo's three gargoyle friends are Victor, Hugo, and this one.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Laverne! [laughs] Victor Hugo wrote the book, so the third one HAD to be different.
